topic: Data ingestion and demographic mapping issues
summary_markdown: The conversation covered two main topics: data timestamp handling and demographic data integration. Regarding timestamps, [p1] confirmed that the `timestamp` field in the raw device buffer (`allunite.raw_devices_seen_buffer`) records the time of packet addition to Kinesis, not necessarily the event time. A separate discussion involved integrating purchased demographic data (for 1200 cities) which provided two datasets: raw GPS for 1200 places and detailed demographics for 475 sub-districts. The user successfully mapped this detailed demographic data onto existing facility metrics but found that even Islamabad was not included in the 475 available locations.
decisions: The timestamp recorded in `allunite.raw_devices_seen_buffer` reflects Kinesis ingestion time.
